Gideon, the only Moss digest I found that lists Orlavine Medical Supply at 55 seats is "Moss: Strategic digest 9/30," dated Wednesday, 30 September 2026. The 55-seat figure is a seat count, not a finance figure, so you can use it.

I couldn't confirm which conversation that digest was posted in. Its header says it was prepared for Ruth, so it may sit somewhere you can't see. Seat counts change, too, so treat 55 as the count as of 30 September. Search was keyword-only, so there could be other digests I didn't match.
